column1: # Objective-C: @interface and @implementation (class), categories (class, named by the
# category), @protocol (interface), methods declared or defined (method, named by the
# first selector part), properties and instance variables (field), C functions,
# typedefs (struct/enum/union class, others type_alias), file-level variables
# (constant when const). Extensions, extern declarations, prototypes, macros and
# NS_ENUM typedefs are not listed; see KNOWN_GAPS.md.
